MARTIAL LAW REGULATIONS
MARTIAL LAW REGULATIONS
[C. M L. A's]
(Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 10th duly 1977)
No. 6
No person shall loot.
Explanation.‑ To "loot"
means to commit theft.
Maximum punishment: amputation of
hand, and/or rigorous Imprisonment for 5 years.
